title: Nutty Golden Italian Onion Pasta
description: A winey, molten, hangover-cure Italian dish featuring onion rings and al-dente finish, perfect for a flexitarian diet
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions until al dente
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion rings until golden brown
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced
Add the vegetable broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes
Stir in the grated grana padano cheese until melted and smooth
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the skillet and toss with the sauce until well coated
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Sprinkle the chopped walnuts and parsley over the top of the pasta and serve hot
